user_story: As a user, I want to delete a task so that I can remove items I no longer need.

positive.title: Successfully delete a task
steps: Step 1: Navigate to the task list.
Step 2: Select the task you want to delete.
Step 4: Confirm the deletion in the confirmation dialog.
positive.expected_result: The task is removed from the task list.

negative.title: Attempt to delete a locked or protected task
steps: Step 1: Navigate to the task list.
Step 2: Select a locked or protected task.
negative.expected_result: The task is not deleted and an error message is displayed indicating the task cannot be deleted.

edge.title: Attempt to delete a task when the task list is empty
steps: Step 1: Navigate to the task list.
Step 2: Attempt to delete a task.
edge.expected_result: The system indicates there are no tasks to delete, and no deletion action is performed.
